required_behavior: Step 0 probe: determine the exact OMP 18.4.5 extension API for registering tools (pi.registerTool signature, parameter schema format, execute signature, how a tool returns text/JSON, abort/timeouts) with a throwaway extension in a temp dir and a scripted/no-network provider (no model prompt) - record the facts in the result.

bridge.ts: register `to_worker` only for role manager and `to_manager` only for role worker (role from the authenticated env), with JSON-schema parameters per the design (to_worker: task_id?, kind 'experiment'|'work', message, spec? {goal, paths[], instructions?, execution?{source, commit, command, criteria, environment names, shell}}, run?; to_manager: kind 'answer'|'progress'|'done'|'blocked'|'report', message, task_id?, in_reply_to?, requires_code_change?, reason?, request?). execute sends {kind:'tool_request', requestId, toolCallId, tool, args, sessionId, generation} over the existing socket and waits for the matching tool_result up to 10 s; on timeout/disconnect returns {status:'outcome_unknown'} and never resends. Results are returned immediately (no waiting for the other OMP).

backend: mailbox _receive accepts tool_request from authenticated peers only; role comes from the peer's hello token (never from the frame); tool/role mismatch -> rejected; idempotence key (role, session_id, generation, toolCallId) returns the first result again. New src/workbench/backend/flow.py HandoffService with a clear interface used by later units: handle(role, request) -> result; an outbox that delivers queued messages through the existing TaskMailbox/bridge deliver path (resend only DEFERRED, never unknown/rejected); journal workflow/handoffs.jsonl (fsync, 0600) of every request/result (reject environment variable values in messages/specs). For U1 the policy is a placeholder: to_worker without an approved active Task returns approval_pending with a stub approval record (U2 implements approvals/scope/run); to_manager without an active Task returns rejected:no_active_task; free-text delivery inside an active Task is queued. Pause state hook: when paused -> held:paused (U3 wires the real pause).
Keep the existing worker marker contract (response_contract deliveries) unchanged; a to_manager call while a staged delivery is pending is rejected by the bridge as today (tool_activity).
acceptance: red->green tests: tests/bridge (fake peer: role-specific tool presence, frame shape, timeout -> outcome_unknown without resend), tests/backend or tests/app for HandoffService (auth/role from token, idempotence, journal, env-value rejection, outbox deferred-only resend, placeholder statuses)

a real-OMP no-model probe proving both tools are registered per role and a tool call round-trips through the backend (use the existing scripted provider approach if available; otherwise a direct extension self-call harness) - document how
run tests/bridge, tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/ui (test_*.py, no pipe, venv), tests/gates/g1_vt; list any *_independent* failures (do not edit them)
rules: No model prompts (no provider requests; block network for OMP runs like earlier probes); OMP runs only with the Workbench-owned home (C-D64) or a fake HOME; never read/print/copy/hash credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp, removed afterwards; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's processes or configs; no commits, no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first, status, probe facts (API), interface of HandoffService for U2/U3, changed paths + sha256, failing independent tests, residue. Korean, <=25 lines.
